result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count the total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3667-L3702){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the current number of nodes (vertices) in the graph. This count includes all nodes that have been added and not deleted. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#b2f90c5e .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Deleting a node immediately lowers the count: ::: {#5c941d99 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.delete_node("B") graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
